mission: Qualify GP350-014 early-step checkpoints rather than doubling down on step72: test heldout trapped RETRACE, nontrapped false RETRACE, general 72-probe accuracy, actual W0 autonomous RETRACE legality and precision, branch bursts, coverages and raw illegal; no checkpoint promotion until demonstrated positive transfer.
negative_results: preserve all, including cases where RETRACE argmax increases on heldout samples yet fires prematurely on autonomous runs
acceptance: Prefer checkpoint with 24-positive trapped RETRACE recall and zero false RETRACE on 24 open-arm negatives, plus 0 premature on-policy RETRACE and no coverage/pressure/generalization regression. No promotion without independent audit.
